name: Lifedrink Co Inc
summary: Lifedrink Company, Inc. operates within Japan's beverage market, specializing in the production and distribution of a diverse array of drinks. Its product portfolio features LDC-branded natural water, green tea, oolong tea, and sparkling water. The company also supplies various specialty teas, including black oolong, pearl barley, rooibos, domestic green tea, Kagoshima tea, and organic barley tea. Furthermore, Lifedrink Company, Inc. markets functional foods with specific health claims, Saicha products, and offers soda for sale via online platforms. Established in 1972, the company maintains its headquarters in Osaka, Japan.
